responsibility: Defines the instruction patterns that specifically back the -mzvector builtin and intrinsic interfaces, rather than generic vector RTL operations. It provides the machine-description side of System z vector builtins such as gather, mask generation, element insertion/extraction, comparison-condition-code helpers, string-search operations, and NNPA-facing vector intrinsics, bridging the builtin tables in s390-builtins.def to concrete RTL patterns.
